sources.title: CosyVoice2.0
sources.snippet: Ultra-Low Latency: CosyVoice 2.0 introduces a large-scale voice generation model technology that integrates offline and streaming modeling, supporting bidirectional streaming speech synthesis. The first packet synthesis latency can reach 150ms with minimal loss in quality.
